messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: inference.queue.backlog.high (P1) — backlog 6.5k reqs, queue depth > 90th % for 6m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345 · cell=us-west-2

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 auto-assigned to Beth (oncall). Escalation policy: infra-team -> oncall-lead. Playbook: inference-backlog.

Beth (oncall): acked. I'm on it, heading to metrics and logs.

Mike (infra): seeing repeated node provision failures in cloud logs: 
```
error: CreateInstancesQuotaExceeded: quota exceeded for project 54321
2026-03-17T15:03:12Z kubelet: failed to attach volume
```
Looks like we can't spin new nodes.

Anya (eng-sre): autoscaler controller shows controller errors: `failed to sync scale subresource: forbidden` and the HPA target unchanged for 10m. Also K8s events show `ScaleTargetRef missing resource` in a couple reconcile loops.

Beth (oncall): ok manual mitigation — can someone scale the inference-cell deployment to +4 replicas to buy time? I'll open support if customers impacted.

Mike (infra): running manual scale now: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/inference-cell -n inference --replicas=8
# kubectl output: scaled
```
Attempting to schedule pods — a few are Pending with image pull ok but no node.

Lee (ops): confirmed backlog dropped to ~2.2k after partial pod scheduling. Latency still elevated, some 503s recorded from edge. Customer impact: minor but affecting a subset of lower-tier customers. Logged in support ticket TICKET-987.

Anya (eng-sre): we can toggle routing to fallback model variant (rtv-quantized) to reduce CPU/GPU pressure and enable prefix KV cache bypass for large requests. Recommend enabling fallback policy for 15m.

Beth (oncall): do it. Anya/Lee coordinate and call it out to apps.

Anya (eng-sre): enabling fallback now -> routing.policy.fallback=rtv-quantized (applied to route /v1/generate*). Patch: `set routing.fallback=true`

incident-bot: Action executed: routing.fallback enabled by Anya. Observability: starting to see tokens/sec improvement.

Mike (infra): opened quota ticket with cloud support (REQ-3344). Cloud ETA ~25m to bump node quota. Meanwhile we're constrained.

Lee (ops): after fallback, backlog trending down: 6500 -> 1200 in 8m, error rate down from 4.1% -> 0.9%. Still watching tail p50/p95.

Beth (oncall): good. Notifying product and support: brief status note to #support and #product. @support-team please triage TICKET-987 for impacted customers.

Anya (eng-sre): creating incident follow-up ticket: PM-INC-4278912345, owners: Anya (root cause), Mike (infra quota), Beth (mitigation/comms). Will include logs and commands.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 escalated to infra lead (Mike) per policy after 10m unacknowledged escalation window.

Beth (oncall): plan: keep fallback for 30m, redeploy autoscaler controller with patch to fix ScaleTargetRef, and then revert routing. If quota not increased, we'll schedule capacity reservation for Dedicated.

Mike (infra): manual redeploy of autoscaler controller started: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/autoscaler -n infra` — monitoring.

Anya (eng-sre): redeploy completed, controller logs show successful reconcile now, HPA reacting to metrics.

incident-bot: Metrics update: backlog trending to 300 by +18m, error rate 0.3%, p95 latency falling.

Beth (oncall): marking incident as under control. Leaving PD incident open until quota ticket closes. Will post postmortem draft tomorrow.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 resolved by Beth (oncall). Resolution summary: manual scale + model fallback + autoscaler redeploy mitigated backlog; root cause = autoscaler reconcile failure + cloud node quota. Follow-up owners assigned.
